text:
peter: Noticed 10 GPUs drop in eu-west1 after the overnight OOB push (~01:10Z). Nodes show NotReady and pods evicted.

sam: Checking OOB logs: several boards reported PCIe AER "Uncorrected error" followed by nvme controller reset. Correlated with secure-boot flag flip during activation on some BMCs.

oncall-ivy: Pausing remaining racks now. deploy-bot: pause request submitted.

deploy-bot: rollout "oob-bmc-2026-03-21" status: PAUSED by oncall-ivy at 01:40Z.

avni: Mitigation: remote revert to previous signed image on affected racks, run 30m fio + 10m GPU burn on each rack, and add BMC time (<1s) and AER prechecks to pipeline.

ben-finance: Heads-up: holding canaries and autoscaler freeze will cost ~85 GPU-hours if this lasts 24h. I've notified budget owners.

sam: Also bump kubelet eviction grace to 8m for eu-west inference pools to reduce reschedule churn while we revert.

peter: Revert started on r04-02. Will post quick pass/fail in 40m. If revert fails, we'll schedule power-cycle + hardware triage.
